method: Compile both Python fences and execute the complete crash/recovery script in an isolated temporary working directory. Require exact stdout equality with the published text fence. Run collision sentinels in the current directory, verify same-key/same-payload deduplication, same-key/different-payload conflict, checkpoint non-advancement on conflict, and JSON boolean-versus-number distinction, and exercise four trailing tool_use helper cases. Review current Anthropic client tool result/error flag guidance and PostgreSQL 18 ON CONFLICT concurrency semantics.
limitations: The file scan followed by append is only a single-process sequential teaching fixture; it does not establish concurrent safety or production idempotency.
No real downstream side effect, network timeout ambiguity, PostgreSQL transaction, or live provider call was exercised.
The historical 2026-10-09 experiment and provider observations were not replayed from raw traces; they remain historical summaries.

Anthropic documents is_error as an error marker for tool execution; the conclusion that it does not prove absence of an external effect is an application-level inference and must be resolved using the downstream contract.
The production screenshots were visually reviewed in light and dark themes; the one browser console error is the existing missing favicon (404).
